svg.title: The Armoury — tech stack
svg.desc: Mobile: Flutter, Dart, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, XML (MVVM), Swift, SwiftUI; Architecture: Clean Architecture, BLoC / Cubit, Provider, MVVM, Hilt, get_it + Injectable, GoRouter, Freezed; Data & APIs: REST · Retrofit, Firebase, Firestore, Cloud Messaging, Hive, Odoo; Backend: Go, Gin, GORM, MySQL / TiDB, JWT, Docker, Render; Payments: KBZPay, WavePay, CB Pay, 2C2P, Coda, MPT, Ooredoo, ATOM, Google Pay, Apple Pay; Tools: Git, Postman
